reference.description: re-computes the (debiased) wPLI from the imaginary cross-spectrum with an independent scipy pipeline, and demonstrates the debiasing (independent -> biased spurious but debiased ~0; lagged -> ~1; zero-lag -> ~0); reports the op wPLI + debiased, the scipy agreement, and the ground-truth contrast
